extra.final_summary: The data had two issues affecting the question: (1) The 'island' column had a lowercase 'dream' that was merged into the allowed 'Dream' label using normalize_labels; (2) Three rows (9, 36, 50) had negative flipper_length_mm values outside the allowed range [170, 235], which were excluded as they are likely data entry errors and cannot be corrected without guessing. After fixes, the analysis shows 37 penguins measured on Biscoe, 19 on Dream, and 10 on Torgersen.
